paper_title: A microwave paraphoton and axion detection experiment with 300 dB electromagnetic shielding at 3 GHz
notes: Microwave LSW (light shining through wall) experiment at CERN, March 2012, searching for paraphotons (hidden photons). Limit reported in text: at m_gamma' = 1.1e-5 eV/c^2, chi = 7.6e-9.
